subject: Post-call outcome memo: C-suite alignment, success metrics, and procurement caveats
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northbridgehealth.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@northbridgehealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call outcome memo: C-suite alignment, success metrics, and procurement caveats

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our side so the leadership team has a single source of truth before your procurement loop: we heard three top priorities and a few risk caveats.

Top priorities (what success looks like)
- Reduce diagnostic question turnaround time from average ~22s to <8s for triage workflows (measurable by Q4 pilot metrics).
- Maintain PHI separation and no persistent logging of raw input across production inference (required by compliance).
- Cost predictability: target unit token cost threshold and a provisioning cadence that aligns with monthly budget approvals.

Key risk/caveats we discussed
- On-prem hosting preference in later phases; initial pilot can run in Redwoods' dedicated pool but must support private VPC in pilot month 3.
- Audit evidence: you asked for SOC 2 section extracts and runtime audit logs for the first 30 days — we attached the security addendum and can produce a scoped export.
- Procurement timeline risk: your procurement team indicated a 6–8 week review for standard terms; any contractual redlines (data residency, indemnity) will add time.

Proposed next steps (timeline & owners)
1) I’ll share a one-pager and a procurement timeline doc (attached) — ACTION: Kimberly — sent (see attachments).
2) Northbridge to confirm pilot exec sponsor and legal review owner by Wed 9/1 — ACTION: Elena.
3) Redwood prepares a pilot SOW draft + constrained pricing range for the exec call next Tuesday — ACTION: Ben.
4) Security team to prepare the requested SOC extracts and runtime log sample — ACTION: Redwood Security (cc’d in related link).

Attachments: Northbridge_Redwood_OnePager.pdf; Procurement_Timeline_NBH.xlsx; Redwood_Security_Addendum.pdf

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute exec sync (vendor + your CIO + procurement lead) next week to get sponsor alignment and decision triggers documented.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1-415-555-0128

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference for production LLMs
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northbridgehealth.com>

Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@northbridgehealth.com>, procurement@northbridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call outcome memo: C-suite alignment, success metrics, and procurement caveats

Thanks Kimberly — very helpful summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot exec sponsor: confirming CIO (Rajiv Patel) will be the sponsor; I’ll loop him in once we have the SOW and cost range.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 extracts are great; can you also provide an example of the runtime audit export format (we need to validate ingestion into our analytics)?
- Pricing: procurement wants a not-to-exceed range by feature set (chat + embeddings + private deployment). If you can split pilot pricing vs. expected run rate for 6–12 months, that will help.

I’ll aim to confirm legal/procurement owner by EOD Wed (9/1). If Redwood can propose an exec sync on Mon 9/6, that should work after I confirm Rajiv’s availability.

Elena
Director of Product Strategy | Northbridge Health
elena.soto@northbridgehealth.com

Team — forwarding the Northbridge thread. Key asks for us:

1) Pricing ask: Ben, can you produce a 2-column price view by 9/1 EOD (Pilot band vs. 6–12m run-rate) with option for dedicated vs private deployment? Procurement specifically requested a NTE range and a short note on the cost delta for VPC/on-prem readiness.

2) SOW / Pilot scope: Marissa, please draft a 1-page pilot SOW we can share with Rajiv that lists: success metrics (latency, accuracy, cost), timeline (8–12 week pilot with private deployment option at month 3), limited data-handling commitments, and rollback/fallback plan.

3) Security evidence: attach runtime audit export example and short note on retention/config — Ben, coordinate with Security to pull a sample CSV of runtime events (redact PII).

I’ll propose Mon 9/6 10:00am PT for the exec sync to Elena once Ben and Marissa confirm materials ready.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Elena / Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a concise pricing note (excerpted here) and the NTE bands you requested. Full XLS attached in the thread (Procurement_Timeline_NBH.xlsx).

Pricing summary (pilot vs run-rate) — excerpt
- Pilot (8–12 weeks): $12k–$18k (flat for reserved pilot capacity + limited tokens, includes onboarding support).
- 6–12 month run-rate: $9k–$24k/month depending on usage bands and private deployment options.
- VPC/private deployment uplift: +35–60% on infrastructure line items (depends on throughput targets and on-prem hardware footprint).

Decision triggers for exec sync
- Sponsor signs off on pilot SOW and approves NTE pilot band.
- Procurement confirms an initial purchase order for pilot (PO amount: $15k recommended).
- Security signs off on evidence package (SOC extracts + runtime sample).

Next steps
- Kimberly to schedule Mon 9/6 10:00am PT if Rajiv confirms.
- Ben to upload final pricing XLS by EOD today.
- Marissa to circulate SOW draft by EOD today.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
